parameters.content:
## QF-MVP-50.2B — SELF-HOSTED STAGING CANDIDATE

**KEEP INACTIVE / UNPUBLISHED.**

Default path is fail-closed because `QF_N8N_TRANSPORT_ENABLED` must equal `true`.

Secrets are runtime env references only; never paste secret values into this workflow.

Required later on self-hosted n8n: `QF_CORE_STAGING_BASE_URL`, `QF_N8N_WORKER_ID`, `QF_N8N_TO_CORE_HMAC_SECRET`, `QF_CORE_TO_N8N_HMAC_SECRET`, `QF_N8N_TRANSPORT_ENABLED`.

50.2B verifies the signed claim handshake only. Routing, Meta and WhatsApp remain disabled.
